Senior Backend Engineer — Acme Logistics (Remote, US)

About the role:
You will own the services that assign loads to drivers in real time.

What you'll do:
- Design and build dispatch APIs used by 400 carriers
- Own reliability of our event pipeline
- Mentor engineers on the team

Requirements:
- 5+ years building backend services in Node.js or TypeScript
- Strong PostgreSQL skills, including query optimisation
- Experience designing REST APIs
- Experience mentoring junior engineers
- Clear written communication

Nice to have:
- Kafka or other event streaming systems
- Familiarity with logistics or freight is a plus

Benefits:
- Remote-first, 25 days PTO

Frontend Developer
We need a React developer to help build our dashboard.

Product Designer, Globex Analytics

Globex is looking for a product designer to shape our retail dashboards.

You have:
- 3+ years designing B2B SaaS products
- A portfolio showing end-to-end product design work
- Comfort running usability tests with customers
- Strong collaboration with engineers and product managers

Bonus points for:
- Experience with data visualisation
- Figma prototyping
